labBytesMethod: sha256 of the lines "<sha256>  <path>" for every Git-tracked file under the lab directory, sorted by path, one per line (shasum -a 256 output format)

command.test: node --test --test-reporter=tap (cwd tests) with LAB_PROJECT pointing at the private staged project

starterCheck: the shipped starter failed all 16 named tests, matching expected/starter-summary.txt
privateStaging: the staged project, including its solution files, lives only in uncommitted private staging outside the repository; no solution, hidden test, or hash of either is recorded here
